desc: Derive edge-contribution probabilities and the prefix-sum formula for the random recursive tree.

Implement the complete Python program for the O(N+Q) edge-contribution solution: precompute modular inverses up to N+1 and fact=(N-1)! mod 998244353; build prefB[i]=sum_{k=2..i} A_k*2(k-1)/(k(k+1)) and prefC[i]=sum_{k=2..i} A_k/k; for each query u<v compute ans = prefB[u-1] + (A_u*(u-1)/u if u>=2 else 0) + (prefC[v-1]-prefC[u]) + A_v modulo 998244353, multiply by fact, and print; then run the program on the three provided samples and verify the outputs exactly.
